name: Pension-Ferienwohnungen Bramböck
beschreibung: Pension-Ferienwohnungen Bramböck in Bad Häring offers holiday apartments for self-caterers. The quiet location on the edge of town affords a view of the Inntal and the surrounding mountains. Each holiday apartment is equipped with a fully fitted kitchen and its own bathroom. The style of the accommodation is down-to-earth and family-run. The guesthouse is suitable for families and couples who want an independent holiday. There is no food offering at the guesthouse itself, as guests prepare their meals independently. Dining options in the town are within walking distance.
